sections.title: Local processing
sections.text: Your images and data never leave your device. We respect your privacy. No uploads. No tracking. No cloud dependencies.

sections.title: Your preferences
sections.text: Settings like theme or language are stored only in your browser (via local storage) to improve your experience. You’re in control, always.

sections.title: No account needed
sections.text: No registration, no passwords. Just open and create.
By using this application, you agree to these principles.

confirmResetLocalPreferences.title: Clear Preferences
confirmResetLocalPreferences.text: Are you sure you want to clear your preferences? This will reset your settings.
